messages:
maria: short RFC follow-up: propose unifying rate limit + fairness into a single 'credit steering' surface. admission mints a credit, steering adjusts budgets asynchronously.

lee: how does this differ from token-bucket + scheduler today?

maria: token-bucket = admission-only. steering adds an eventual policy layer that writes budget deltas into a ledger. admission reads local ledger snapshot for O(1) checks.

rahul: multi-hop concern (edge -> region -> gpu-pool). risk of double-charge or conflicting grants.

maria: each request carries credit_id + HMAC. admission honors epoch in ledger entry. steering reconciles and emits compensating deltas if miscounts found.

zoe: ops questions: rollout path and canary?

maria: plan: deploy write-only ledger + local cache behind FF; run steering in probe mode for telemetry; run 5% canary for tenants >500 rps for 48h; flip per-route. rollbacks on >4% error spike or >6% p95 regress.

lee: consistency model? can't block on cross-region raft.

maria: bounded-staleness reads: local replica with max_age 200ms; steering merges cross-region and increments epoch for compensating writes. admission rejects applies only if epoch <= local_epoch. metrics: ledger_stale_reads, epoch_rejects, reconciliation_count.

rahul: tests & DR: unit tests for epoch monotonicity, chaos sim for region partition + rejoin, DR runbook for steering partition => safe-mode fallback to conservative static buckets.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: suggested canary checklist added to ops runbook. monitor p50/p95, error-rate, credit_rebalances.

maria: thanks all. i'll draft a short addendum with ledger schema, proto sketch, and the canary checklist. @zoe @rahul please review for DR edge cases.
